Push-set pool and LRU list management for gossip transaction build entries.

# Purpose
This file implements a `push_set` data structure for `fd_gossip_txbuild` state management. It defines `push_set_entry_t` objects that combine a transaction build object, pool metadata, and last-hit list links, then uses generated `fd_pool` and `fd_dlist` code to manage storage and ordering. The [`push_set_new`](<#push_set_new>) function allocates and initializes shared memory for the pool and the last-hit list, and [`push_set_join`](<#push_set_join>) attaches to an existing shared-memory region. The [`push_set_pop_append`](<#push_set_pop_append>) function updates an entry timestamp and moves that entry to the tail of the last-hit list.
